name: WebSocket Echo Tester
blurb: open a socket, send messages and list replies with timestamps
intro: In the app, Connect opens the socket from this page, sends your messages and keeps a timestamped transcript; the results pair each reply with what was sent (round trip) and explain the close code (RFC 6455). Without the app, paste a transcript to have it read.

inputs.label: Send
options: The whole text as one message

inputs.label: Transcript (written by a live session, or pasted)

examples.title: Echo server session with two messages

usage: Give the url (ws:// or wss://), optional comma-separated protocols, the messages (one per line, or mode whole for one message) and optionally a transcript of lines '<ISO time> <-|->|** <text>' (-> sent, <- received, ** event such as open or close 1006). It returns URL checks, message and frame sizes, sent/received counts, echo round-trip times, the handshake time and the close code with its meaning, plus JavaScript and websocat snippets. Agents cannot open sockets through run(): they read a transcript captured in the app or produced with websocat.
sources: RFC 6455 The WebSocket Protocol: sections 3 (URIs), 4.1 (subprotocol tokens), 5.2 (framing), 7.4.1 (close codes)
WHATWG WebSockets Standard (browser API, mixed content)
